g.text: Reading an image reference — every part has a job
latest is not a version. It is the DEFAULT tag name, and the publisher can repoint it at a different image whenever they like —
so the same command can build something different tomorrow. Pin a real tag and every machine gets the same bits.
nginx@sha256:5616878291a2eed594aee8db4dade5878cf7edcb475e59193904b198d9b830de <- a digest is the only truly immutable reference
